decision: Selected the US Census Bureau geocoder point for 2341 Echo Road, Lithia Springs, GA 30122, the facility address that Georgia EPD's public advisory PA0826-4 gives for 'Amazon Data Services, Inc ATL088 Campus' (air application 30292), as the campus locator. No official parcel geometry was reachable: the Douglas County GIS host disallows its /arcgis/, /image/ and /portal/ paths in robots.txt (recorded by the us-ga-sc-nc-p3 hold), and ArcGIS Online feature hosts answer robots.txt with HTTP 403.
conversion: Geocoder output in NAD83 geographic coordinates used as WGS84 without transformation (sub-metre difference at this scale); rounded to 7 decimals.
identity_bridge: Georgia EPD Air Protection Branch public advisory PA0826-4 (PDF created 26 August 2026; comments due 25 September 2026) lists, under DOUGLAS COUNTY: Facility Name 'Amazon Data Services, Inc ATL088 Campus', Application No 30292, Facility Address '2341 Echo Road, Lithia Springs, 30122', Description of Operation 'Data Processing, Hosting, and Related Services', Reason for Application 'Construct and operate a data center'.
The Census geocoder matches that address exactly (2341 ECHO RD, LITHIA SPRINGS, GA, 30122) on TIGER/Line edge 16649788, right side, address range 2301-2419, in Douglas County.
not_used: No map service, map viewport, embedded map widget, short link, directory coordinate, OpenStreetMap service or county centroid was used. The Atlas source record aws-douglas-county-georgia (a county-level point for AWS's undisclosed Douglas County campuses) is not used as a locator.
nearby_records_within_2km: Flexential Douglasville North River Campus (1.57 km) and DC BLOX Atlanta West Campus (1.61 km), both different operators and properties; no Atlas source record, identity-mapping coordinate, pending queue addition, locator correction or claim lies within 2 km.
precision_note: The point is the geocoder's interpolated position for the address along the Echo Road segment, not the campus parcel, a building or a surveyed boundary; the campus extent and its offset from the street are unknown.
